proposed_owner.admission: Not a generic metadata update. Resolve open documents, putaway tasks, holds, allocations and original-family UNKNOWN before admitting a new repack. Never delete their journal or change identity.
proposed_owner.atomicity: One DB transaction; lock container, receipt key, old mappings, donor mappings/loose-allocation source, relevant inventory dimensions and source documents in deterministic order. Recheck all versions/ACL after locks. Coordinate with existing issue/putaway writers using the same locks.
proposed_owner.conservation: Old mappings retain immutable trace/reason/actor/time; deactivate rather than relabel. Account for old units at an explicit verified destination, not disappearance. Allocate the new quantity from proven unallocated available stock or transfer an existing allocation exactly once. No SKU/unit conversion, stock ledger, receipt/issue posting, status override or invented putaway.
proposed_owner.stock_invariant: All affected SKU warehouse balance totals, available/reserved/unavailable and ledger fingerprints unchanged. Active quantity allocations plus loose source never exceed permitted existing stock; SKU-level available is not BOX availability.
proposed_owner.commit: Insert new content and append-only operation/audit before commit; adjust parent version once; preserve physical/NFC identity. Placement/status can only change by their actual canonical owner. Receipt has before/after mapping/hash/version, quantity/unit provenance, stock_effect=NONE and SUCCEEDED.
proposed_owner.recovery: Persist original key/body/version before HTTP. Timeout is UNKNOWN/CHECK_ONLY. GET reconciles same actor/session/warehouse/parent/fingerprint. No automatic replay, key change, version rebasing, compensating document or new-login takeover.
proposed_owner.cache: After-commit targeted existing stock/container read namespace invalidation, never global flush
proposed_owner.schema_review: Durable operation receipt and allocation/disposition evidence may require reviewed additive schema; no migration is supplied or authorized here
